newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK stocks likely to move in sideways pattern.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks likely to move in sideways pattern.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks are expected to trend sideways in a relatively stable pattern on Monday, with China plays continuing to attract the market's active investors, brokers said.
"The market's going to be flat. China stocks should do well but interest rate sensitive stocks won't do too much," said Gary Wong, sales director at Vickers Ballas.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index closed 8.76 points higher at 12,549.94 on Friday. The Dow Industrials later added 44.95 points to close at 6,703.55 after a day of volatile price movements.
While the short-term technical picture has improved, the longer term outlook is still weak, brokers said.

Momentum indicators on the daily chart have turned slightly positive but on the weekly chart the 10-week moving average looks set to cut below the 40-week moving average, suggesting a further large consolidation over time, technical analysts said.
H share Jilin Chemical will report its 1996 results later on Monday. The company requested a suspension of trading in its shares just before the market opened.
